fact: A 2026 invitation for bids seeks a vendor to configure and validate a data exchange layer (iFIX) linking Ethiopian government financial systems IBEX and IFMIS, procurement platforms and health systems DHIS2 HMIS for the Health Resource Tracking solution.
title: Terms of Reference for the Implementation and Technical Support of the Health Resource Tracking (HRT) Solution Using Modular and Standards-Based Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)
